items.title: Gambling Commission operator register dataset (operators, premises, regulatory actions)
items.why: Exchange 2026-W39 runner-up. 2,642 operators, daily CSV/ZIP, no login; Apify actors price it from $8/1k rows; KYB/payments/affiliate-compliance buyers. LICENCE CONFIRMED 2026-09-24 by the interactive session: data.gov.uk record 'Operator licence register' (Gambling Commission) is marked UK Open Government Licence v3 (rel=dc:rights → nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/; CKAN license_id uk-ogl). Files under https://www.gamblingcommission.gov.uk/downloads/ (all 200, text/csv, no login, browser UA): business-licence-register-businesses.csv (Account Number,Licence Account Name; 92 KB), business-licence-register-licences.csv (Account Number,Licence Number,Status,Type,Activity,Start Date,End Date; 493 KB), business-licence-register-trading-names.csv (Account Number,Trading Name,Status), business-licence-register-domain-names.csv (Account Number,Domain Name,Status), premises-licence-register.csv (Account Number,Account Name,Premises Activity,Local Authority,Address Line 1,Address Line 2,City,Postcode). business-licence-register-activities.csv does NOT exist (404). Values are double-quoted, blank dates empty. BUILT 2026-09-24 (17:00 run): v0.17.0 — licence/domain/premises rows in one D1 table, wave 2, Apify actor; ingest written blind against the recorded headers (origin unreachable from the build container), first live run 05:15 tomorrow; a failure shows in the metrics row and the next run fixes it.
items.proof: queries + paywall hits on the dataset in 30 days (Analytics Engine)

items.title: Fix the nhs-ods refresh error reported in the 2026-09-23 metrics row
items.why: First live wave-6 run (05:55) errored. The ingest was written without access to files.digital.nhs.uk and the build container still has no egress to NHS hosts or to gankdat.com, so the refresh_log message cannot be read from a routine; the fix needs the error text. RESOLVED 2026-09-24 (interactive): refresh_log said `ODS etr.zip download failed: 403` — files.digital.nhs.uk/assets/ods/current/<file>.zip now 403s for every user agent (only the *arc archive ZIPs remain); the current reports moved to https://www.odsdatasearchandexport.nhs.uk/api/getReport?report=<file>, served as plain CSV (all six files 200 with the Worker's UA, same 27-column layout). Source rewired, ZIP step dropped.
items.proof: nhs-ods loads ~45k rows and the metrics row shows no refresh error

items.title: Agent-side sign-up at the paywall: MCP tool takes an email, issues a key once the magic link is clicked
items.why: 20–160 paywall hits/day are agents that cannot become customers: sign-up is a human magic-link flow. Diagnosis 2026-09-24. BUILT 2026-09-25 (09:00 run, v0.18.0): keyless MCP tools request_api_key (email → approval email with an RFC 8628-style code) and claim_api_key (poll → key once), REST twins POST /v1/auth/agent-signup and /agent-signup/claim, GET-then-POST /v1/auth/approve page for the human; D1 migration 0011; keys named agent:<client>; every keyless 401 and llms.txt/docs/landing point at it; daily metrics row now carries 'agent sign-up: req/24h, keys/24h, keys/30d' (the proof).
items.proof: ≥ 5 keys issued via the agent path in 30 days
